Sadashiv sir is very cooperative.
I had some health issue and I requested the team to pause my course, which they did.
My mentor was Dhiraj Tupare.
I chose him after seeing his work.
During the beginning of the mentorship, he was very active in correcting my mistakes. But, when I proceeded and reached the portrait module, he started ignoring my mistakes. He use to say “I will get back to you later” but never returned and never tried to notice my work. Although, he was very much active in responding to other people’s work.
All the corrections in my portraits were done by me by comparing my work to fellow artists.

Overall, the course is very good.
Sadashiv sir and team is very cooperative but I didn’t like the mentorship of Dhiraj sir. It was below my expectations.
